purpose: Limited primary-source refresh for the provisional first-prototype recommendation; not a new market census or sales forecast.
method: Opened official Steam product pages, a developer's own Lyca account and Valve's wishlist guidance. Did not refresh normalized prices or the historical review-count dataset. Search-result estimates were excluded from financial conclusions.
